name: section-label
description: Shared section-label primitive. customJS.SectionLabel.render(dv, { text, top? }) renders a small uppercase muted label + hairline divider above — the canonical replacement for ## H2 section headings across every blueprint. Promoted verbatim from the project blueprint helper (sauce v0.109.0 S2) into a mechanism at v0.122.0 so non-project blueprints no longer depend on the project blueprint for it. Class name unchanged (SectionLabel) — existing dv.view + customJS.SectionLabel.render callers keep working. FilterBar (filter-bar.js): the To-Do filter grammar as shared primitives — search field, day-cell strip, pill tabs and pill menus (MenuPopover), day pill, caption, hairline rule, SectionLabel day sections, plus pure Monday-first date helpers — used by the meetings view. Unversioned-release note (#910): FilterBar (filter-bar.js) and its customjs_classes / files entries shipped in the v0.307.1 tarball without a version bump for this component, because the v0.307.1 release PR was computed from #909 before #910 landed and merged after it; the installer skips a component whose installed version is unchanged, so vaults never received it. The next patch carries it.
